integrity: Complete integer intersection-form proof and exhaustive verifier of the 27 exceptional-line classes, 72 sixers, 36 double-sixes and all 720 label permutations; no independent scientific audit.
scientific_limitations: Requires a smooth cubic surface obtained from six distinct Frobenius-stable general-position plane points. No claim for all cubic surfaces, or existence of every cycle type over every finite field. Prior Weyl-group permutation-character computations may imply the orbit table. Independently validated priority and mathematical review are outstanding.
title: Frobenius orbit spectra of sixers and double-sixes on six-point blowup cubic surfaces
